# TrueFoundry

> > TrueFoundry is an enterprise MLOps and LLMOps platform for deploying, governing, and scaling AI/ML models and agentic workflows with unified observability.

TrueFoundry provides infrastructure for machine learning operations, featuring AI Gateway for model routing, Agent Gateway for agentic workflows, and comprehensive tooling for model deployment, monitoring, and cost optimization on Kubernetes. The platform emphasizes enterprise-grade governance, observability, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integration.

## Key Topics

- AI Gateway
- Agent Gateway
- LLMOps
- Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- Enterprise AI Governance
- Kubernetes
- Model Deployment
- Observability & Monitoring
- Cost Optimization
- Agentic AI Workflows
- Drift Tracking
- Latency Analysis
- Model Serving
- Load Testing
- Docker
